server_config.description: Editable YAML settings, excluding secrets and module-managed options. Omitted: keep the current settings.

ios_push.description: Forward poll requests to ntfy.sh (or the previous upstream) for iOS instant notifications. Omitted: keep the current state.

upstream_access_token.description: Token for the upstream server, stored in passwords.env. Empty: remove it. Omitted: keep it.

web_push_public_key.description: Web Push public key, stored in passwords.env. Empty: remove it. Omitted: keep it.

web_push_private_key.description: Web Push private key, stored in passwords.env. Empty: remove it. Omitted: keep it.
